text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin), and mild coagulopathy (elevated INR). There is also monocytosis, basophilia, and mild hyperchloremia. These findings suggest a significant systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or severe inflammation, with associated hematologic and coagulation abnormalities. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
